response.overview: There was a girl — Catherine Miller — who is constantly getting bullied and abused by her classmates. No one is on her side, except her best friend, Sasha Liz Stevens.  Sasha is nothing but good to her. She often protects her from everything. The only reason why Catherine can survive the everyday hell in their school was because of Sasha.  On a Wednesday, Catherine didn't go to school which was weird because even though she doesn't have a very good experiences there, she'll always be present. Even Sasha didn't know what happened or why she's absent.  After that, every wednesday, eerie things begin to circulates within the class.  What happened to her? Who or what caused this? How will they get through this? Are they going to survive?
response.title: Miércoles
